This deck focuses on utilizing cheap spells to trigger the ability of Arclight Phoenix and bring it back from the graveyard to the battlefield multiple times in a game. It also includes tempo plays and disruptive elements to control the game while building towards bringing back the Phoenix for repeated attacks. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression, resilience, and card advantage.

The deck also includes a few key companions like Yorion, Sky Nomad for additional value. Overall, it aims to dominate the battlefield through careful resource management and strategic card selection.
